headline.zh: 百年法式建筑里的西餐下午茶
headline.en: Afternoon tea in a historic French-style building

traits.zh: 位于原法国俱乐部旧址，保留法国古典装饰风格
traits.en: In former French Club, retains classical French decor

traits.zh: 提供西式便餐、秋季双人下午茶含甜咸点心
traits.en: Serves Western meals and seasonal afternoon tea sets

traits.zh: 菜单含汉堡、肋排、生蚝、牛排、寿司等
traits.en: Menu includes burgers, ribs, oysters, steak, sushi

traits.zh: 面向马路边门，采光良好
traits.en: Good natural light from street-facing entrance

linger.zh: 提供完整餐食与下午茶，适合久坐
